> [!thm] Bézout
> $\gcd(a, b)$ is the least positive $ax + by$.
^bezout

> [!thm] Congruences multiply
> If $a \equiv a'$ and $b \equiv b'$ then $ab \equiv a'b'$.
^cong-arith
